newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS SEEN BULLISH, EYES ON U.S. DATA.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS SEEN BULLISH, EYES ON U.S. DATA.

text.p: *Markka bond yields seen opening 2-4 basis point lower
following overseas as U.S. Treasuries hit 8-mth lows on balanced
budget deal achieved on Monday, dealers say.
*Yield curve seen flattening further as investors expected to
buy long end and sell shorter maturities, although some dealers
said opposite trend possible because curve already flat.
*Eyes on U.S. June new home sales 1700/1400 GMT, but U.S. Q2
advance real GDP Thursday and U.S. July payrolls Friday more
important. Domestic May GDP Thursday seen not market-moving.
*Markka flat in early trade. Seen in 2.950-2.970 range.
